title: Federal Reserve holds interest rates steady as inflation cools
summary: The Federal Reserve kept its benchmark interest rate unchanged at a range of 4.25% to 4.5%, citing continued progress on inflation. Chair Jerome Powell told reporters the committee was 'in no hurry' to adjust policy and would rely on incoming inflation and labor-market data to guide future decisions.

sentiment.rationale: Straight policy reporting with no evaluative framing. The article describes the decision and quotes the Fed chair without adopting a position.

key_claims.claim: The Federal Reserve held its benchmark interest rate at 4.25-4.5%.
The committee was in no hurry to adjust policy.
Inflation has cooled meaningfully but remains above the 2% target.
